mapper.insert: insert into users (user_id, user_password, user_name, user_phone, user_email) values (#{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{userName}, #{userPhone}, #{userEmail})
mapper.select: select * from users where user_id = #{userId} and user_password = #{userPassword}
mapper.update: update users set user_state = 0, deactiveuntil = sysdate + interval '60' day where user_key = #{userKey}
mapper.select: select count(*) from users where user_id = #{userId} and user_state = 1
select count(*) from users where user_id = #{userId} and deactiveuntil > sysdate
